name: HyperWrite
tagline: The core loop is small enough for a capable coding agent to produce a useful local version in one sitting. For HyperWrite, draft, rewrite, and answer questions using user-selected context and personal templates. The hard boundary is browser presence, personalization history, and proprietary agent workflows, plus workflow, data, and model tuning.
